params:
# Nav2 Collision Monitor (ros-humble-nav2-collision-monitor 1.1.x, unmodified) for the Go2 dodge.
# Input:  /avoid/cloud_obstacles  - lidar points already in base_footprint, floor and the robot's own
#                                   legs removed (sim/avoid/guard.py), so no TF tree is needed.
#         /cmd_vel_raw            - the velocity our controller wants (Twist; linear.y = sideways).
# Output: /cmd_vel                - the same velocity, reduced so the footprint does not reach an
#                                   obstacle within time_before_collision.
collision_monitor:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: True
    base_frame_id: "base_footprint"
    odom_frame_id: "odom"              # unused: base_shift_correction is off
    cmd_vel_in_topic: "cmd_vel_raw"
    cmd_vel_out_topic: "cmd_vel"
    transform_tolerance: 0.1
    source_timeout: 0.3                # older lidar data is not used
    base_shift_correction: False       # no odometry dependency (may stop with sport mode off)
    stop_pub_timeout: 0.5
    polygons: ["FootprintApproach"]
    FootprintApproach:
      type: "polygon"
      action_type: "approach"
      # Humble 1.1.x: an "approach" polygon with only static `points` SILENTLY NEVER TRIGGERS
      # (measured with cm_probe.py: 1.0 m/s passed into a wall). It takes the footprint from a
      # topic; the controller publishes the Go2 outline (incl. legs ~0.84 x 0.40 m, +5 cm) there:
      # x +-0.47, y +-0.25, frame base_footprint. `points` stays as documentation.
      points: [0.47, 0.25, 0.47, -0.25, -0.47, -0.25, -0.47, 0.25]
      footprint_topic: "/avoid/footprint"
      time_before_collision: 1.5       # tuned in test_avoid.py (the dog needs ~0.3 s to brake)
      simulation_time_step: 0.02
      max_points: 2                    # >= 3 points inside -> obstacle (same rule as guard.py)
      visualize: False
      enabled: True
    observation_sources: ["cloud"]
    cloud:
      type: "pointcloud"
      topic: "/avoid/cloud_obstacles"
      min_height: 0.05
      max_height: 1.0
      enabled: True

notes: no side with room: no dodge
